name: all-japan-grid
title: All-Japan-Grid: an OSM-derived, externally validated model of Japan's transmission network
description: Japan's 10 regional transmission networks (50/60 Hz) extracted from OpenStreetMap with per-field provenance, exported to interchange formats (GeoJSON, CIM/CGMES Level 1+2, MATPOWER, pandapower), and scored against utility ground truth (TEPCO per-line flows; Kansai-TD voltage disclosure). Substation counts differ by layer: the source OSM substation count is 6,962 (see `substations.geojson`), while the published display/built view `subs_all.geojson` expands to 8,994 by voltage class (site-aware, one bus per voltage class). Sourced plant capacity (`capacity_mw_sourced`) is a display/provenance layer and is NOT used by the power-flow builder, which reads `capacity_mw`. See docs/reports/ for the formal review, international benchmark, and known limitations.

sources.title: National Land Numerical Information P03 power plants (MLIT, Japan)
WRI Global Power Plant Database v1.3.0 (CC-BY-4.0)

resources.name: lines_all
resources.title: Transmission lines (all voltages)
resources.description: 19,031 transmission line features derived from the canonical built model (voltage-class tiers also in lines_275kv.geojson / lines_154kv.geojson). Properties: _region, _voltage_kv, _display_name.

resources.name: substations_source
resources.title: Substations (source OSM layer, rich attributes)
resources.description: 6,962 source OSM substations with rich attributes (name_en, operator, voltage_kv, frequency_hz).

resources.name: substations_display
resources.title: Substations (built/display view, voltage-class expanded)
resources.description: 8,994 substation features from the built model (site-aware, one bus per voltage class). Distinct from the 6,962 source count above.

resources.name: plants_all
resources.title: Power plants
resources.description: 19,138 power-plant features. Sourced capacity (160 plants) is surfaced as capacity_mw_sourced / capacity_source_url (display-only; power flow uses capacity_mw). See DATA_DICTIONARY.md §3.4.

resources.name: built_model
resources.title: Canonical built topology
resources.description: 17,333 nodes / 19,031 edges; 829 inter-region edges; main component 11,423; the source of truth for map, editor, Ybus and power-flow tooling.

resources.name: capacity_provenance
resources.title: Sourced generator capacity (provenance DB)
resources.description: 160 capacity values, each with source_url + verbatim quote + confidence + retrieved_at (machine-verified by scripts/capacity_provenance.py verify = 160 ok / 0 bad). Sources: operator-official 62, Wikipedia 87 (CC-BY-SA), gov 5, news 4, IR 1, other 1.

resources.name: cgmes_level2
resources.title: CIM/CGMES 2.4.15 Level-2 power-flow case (index)
resources.description: IEC 61970 CGMES 2.4.15 Level-2 profiles (EQ/TP/SSH/SV/GL) for all 10 regions; validated 0 dangling references (scripts/validate_cgmes.py) and pandapower cim2pp round-trip. Full XML set is a GitHub Release asset (okinawa sample + boundary tracked in-repo).

resources.name: wri_power_plants
resources.title: WRI Global Power Plant Database (Japan rows, external cross-check)
resources.description: WRI GPPD v1.3.0 used for external cross-checking of plant capacity / fuel. Per-record vintage in year_of_capacity_data / commissioning_year.

resources.name: pref_demand_fy2024
resources.title: Prefecture-level electricity demand FY2024 (sourced)
resources.description: 47-prefecture annual electricity demand (特別高圧/高圧/低圧/合計, GWh), extracted from METI/ANRE 電力調査統計 3-(2) 都道府県別電力需要実績 FY2024 with source URL, verbatim quotes and checksum in _meta. Used by the opt-in --pref-demand spatial demand allocation (intervention registry #19).
